subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
If we arrange the ADCs according to their speed of 
operation then which of the following is true? 
 
(a) Counter type > SAR type > Dual slope type 
> Flash type 
 
(b) Flash type > Counter type > SAR type > Dual 
slope type 
 
(c) Dual slope type > Counter type > SAR type 
> Flash type 
 
(d) Flash type > SAR type > Counter type 
> Dual slope type 
 
[MCQ]

options.text: Counter type > SAR type > Dual slope type
Flash type > Counter type > SAR type > Dual
Dual slope type > Counter type > SAR type
Flash type > SAR type > Counter type

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-14 (Digital Electronics Practice Sheet 14).
